title: BOC finds cigarettes, machines for making them in Bulacan

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) uncovered on Wednesday a warehouse in Bustos, Bulacan, storing assorted cigarettes, including Cannon Menthol cigarettes, cigarette manufacturing machines, shredded tobacco leaves, and other cigarette-making materials during a joint enforcement operation. Acting on an intelligence report, Customs Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza issued a letter of authority (LOA), authorizing the inspection of the premises by the BOC in coordination with the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and the Philippine National Police (PNP).
